title: Midnight Sunwatch
text:
🌙 Midnight Sunwatch — October 23, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Moderate (C1.4)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B8.7 (Peaked October 22, 2026 at 21:10 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 428 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.67)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G1 Predicted

Things are pretty calm. 🖤☀️

A compact bright active region with a small sunspot group is visible near the Sun’s east limb; otherwise, the disk looks fairly routine.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 335 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
